segments.sensitive: One reviewer with super sensitive, dry, acne-prone skin reports this as the best product she has used, with no irritation mentioned.
segments.dry: A reviewer with super sensitive dry skin found it effective on acne spots without additional dryness beyond the gel drying out visibly, which another reviewer notes as a general downside of the formula.

concerns.spots: Multiple reviewers report that acne marks and spots dry out and lessen in intensity quickly, including shrinkage of a blackhead over a couple of uses and a stubborn spot with twice-daily use; one describes a pimple gone overnight.
concerns.blemishes: Reviewers describe it drying up sores, pimples, blisters and open zits, with one noting it dries the blemish but not the surrounding skin.
concerns.oiliness: One reviewer states the texture leaves no oil after use.

aspects.libelle: Can dry out and flake with use
Tacky texture that dries down quickly
Stays on skin for extended wear

extraits.texte: I absolutely love this treatment! I have super sensitive dry skin that is acne-prone and this is by far the best product I've ever used. I like that it's tacky when it comes out but dries down really well and really quickly. My acne spots actually shrink when I use this, especially twice a day on a super stubborn spot! I highly recommend, the price is also pretty good for what you get; worth it for sure!!

I love using the star treatment. It dries out and lessens the intensity of any acne mark I apply it to, and does so quickly! My only qualm about it is that it can get dry and flaky like any other gel, so now, I stick to using it in my evening routine.
Dries up blemishes but not skin. I used it on a blackhead in a hard to reach spot of my back and it shrunk significantly in a couple of uses.

I really like this treatment it dries up sores , pimples etc , it has a nice tingling sensation when you apply it. It also stays on for a while. Definitely worth giving it a try if you suffer from blisters or open zits any blemishes really. Definitely recommend trying it.

Perfect addition to my skincare routine and it works. I've always had annoying acne and as I got older yeah it got slightly better but I still have those stubborn guys. Starface has been a godsend for me!
I am genuinely so stunned by how fast and effective this product is on my pimples!! put it on before bed and then put a star over top and I woke up to a spotless face! highly recommended by me < 3
Loveeee this stuff!! The texture is perfect and doesn't leave any sort of oil and works great for me!

reserve: The sample is small (12 reviews, only one below 5 stars) and most reviewers do not specify their skin type, so segment-level conclusions beyond acne-prone and one sensitive/dry case are limited.
